reason: I saw one LinkedIn ad and I've never heard of FLUGIA. I might book the free demo to see it, but I'm not paying 99 euros a month to an unknown company until someone sets it up and shows me it brings in leads or saves me hours.
objection: I don't know if FLUGIA will still exist in two years, and I don't want to hook my CRM and Google account into something that could vanish or that I'll end up babysitting myself.
would_change_my_mind: A demo where they set it up on my own business and show real results in the first weeks, plus references from small businesses like mine in Belgium or France.
